 Home / News / Something Is Off With Marvel’s ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Countdown Clock, and Fans Smell a Reveal
 By Laura Bais 
 Published on October 23, 2026 October 23, 2026 
 0 Comments 
 Marvel Studios 
 Our Editorial Policy 
 Share: 
 Marvel has a talent for turning the most boring thing imaginable into must-see internet theater. A ticking clock on YouTube has become one of the most closely watched corners of the web, with fans parking it in browser tabs for months just to catch any sign of movement. The ‘ Avengers: Doomsday’ countdown clock is now acting strangely, and that’s all it took to set off a fresh round of speculation.
 The “Doomsday Clock” launched earlier this year as a YouTube stream, shortly after the studio released the fourth teaser for the film. It features the Avengers logo, the phrase “Doomsday Is Coming” and a timer counting down the months, days, hours, minutes and seconds to the film’s release. That graphic is the same one that had been attached to each of the weekly teasers that played in theaters.
 At the time, more than 4,000 people were watching it tick, and fans joked about whether Marvel would really keep it running for nearly a year. Now the clock has done something it wasn’t doing before. The countdown appears to be glitching roughly every 10 seconds, and fans are left scratching their heads over what it could mean.
 The Avengers Doomsday clock for whatever reason is glitching every 10 seconds or so. 
Hmmm
#AvengersDoomsday https://t.co/ZoIS1Mjydg
— Carl 🐍 (@ProjectHurts) October 22, 2026 
 The stream has been a strange kind of fan ritual, and Marvel has used it to mark big moments before. On August 14, as the clock hit 4 months, 3 days, 13 hours and 5 minutes, the visual changed from the green Avengers logo to an image of Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom, the same image used on the film’s new poster. Additional tickets also went on sale at the same moment.
 Sue Storm’s voice was also heard on the stream at one point, which led fans to keep listening for audio clues. Some fans even pranked others by pretending that audio revealing other characters had played, which hadn’t happened. In other words, the clock has trained its audience to look closely.

 ‘Dune: Part Three’ Is Already Outselling ‘The Odyssey,’ and a Monster Opening Could Be Heading for ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ 
 Earlier changes to the countdown have lined up with real announcements. The last time the clock changed, the numbers switched color minutes before the studio released an official trailer. When it hit the 100-day milestone, Marvel released a new teaser in which the timer surfaced throughout.
 That history explains why a small glitch is being treated as a clue. It’s also worth remembering that not every change has led to something big, and fans are quick to read meaning into the smallest details.
 The glitch was spotted just after MLB and Marvel announced that a special look at ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ will air during Game 1 of the World Series on Friday, October 23, at 8 p.m. ET on FOX. The exact time of the reveal hasn’t been announced, and Marvel hasn’t confirmed the format. Speculation suggests it could be an extended scene rather than a standard trailer, possibly featuring a baseball sequence.
 There’s also an unconfirmed rumor that a new trailer could arrive on Friday morning at 9 a.m. ET. Marvel hasn’t confirmed it, so it should be treated with caution. Whether the clock’s behavior is connected to either release is unknown.
 He used to be different.
Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theaters everywhere December 18. Get your tickets now: https://t.co/J5PUbxvAkc https://t.co/OUutSMZneq
— Marvel Studios (@MarvelStudios) August 15, 2026 
 Marvel hasn’t commented on the glitch, and there’s no official explanation. It could be a technical hiccup or a deliberate tease, and nothing so far allows anyone to say which. What is certain is that the film arrives in theaters on December 18, directed by the Russo brothers and starring Downey as Doctor Doom.
 The film is the first Avengers sequel since ‘Avengers: Endgame,’ and it will be followed by ‘Avengers: Secret Wars’ a year later. With the release now less than two months away, even the smallest movement from Marvel gets magnified. This week’s clock may or may not be a signal, but it’s already doing its job by keeping people watching.
 Do you think the glitching Avengers: Doomsday countdown clock is teasing a major reveal?
 Yes, Marvel is deliberately building hype for a new trailer or teaser. 
 The glitch is a hint that a special scene will be revealed during the World Series. 
 It’s just a technical glitch, and fans are reading too much into it. 
 Marvel is teasing a surprise character reveal, possibly Doctor Doom or another major hero. 
 I’ll wait for an official announcement before getting excited.
